name: Beatriz Mesquita
summary: One of the most decorated jiu-jitsu competitors ever (record ten IBJJF black belt world titles, IBJJF Hall of Fame, 2017 ADCC gold per Wikipedia), now 8-0 in MMA and 3-0 in the UFC with three submissions. Age 35, fighting out of American Top Team, former LFA bantamweight champion. She is giving up a lot of height to Macy Chiasson (157.5 cm to 180 cm in our data).

how_they_fight.Striking: Functional, mostly used to close distance: about 3.6 significant strikes a minute. Against Melissa Mullins she kicked and worked to close range, then got hurt in a scrappy exchange and had to clinch (Cageside Press). Her one KO/TKO win was the LFA title fight with Sierra Dinwoodie (R2).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Elite. Six of her eight wins are submissions: rear-naked chokes of Irina Alekseeva (R2) and Montserrat Rendon (R1) and an armbar of Mullins from her guard (R1, 3:16) (Wikipedia, Cageside). She finishes from top and bottom, and about 2 takedowns per 15.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never beaten, but hittable on the feet: Mullins landed several clean shots and had her hurt before she found the armbar (Cageside). Takedown defense is listed at about 53% in our data on a small sample.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: She has never needed more than two rounds. Our data has her wins as R1: four submissions; R2: two submissions, one TKO and one DQ win. She has never seen R3 in MMA, so her late-round cardio is untested.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Calm under fire: she recovered from being hurt and finished Mullins off her back. Short MMA career (pro debut June 2024) means limited film against a long, experienced opponent.

patterns: Gets the fight to the mat, then hunts the back or an arm
Six submissions in eight wins; three straight in the UFC
concerns: Big height and reach gap against Chiasson
Striking defense: was hurt by Mullins
keys_to_beat: Use length and keep her at range with the jab and kicks
Stay off the mat and out of her guard; don't throw lazy strikes from top
Make it a three-round fight and test her conditioning

news.text: Submitted Melissa Mullins with an armbar at 3:16 of R1 after being hurt early.
Wikipedia lists her at No. 11; the UFC.com event page shows the Chiasson bout as No. 9 vs No. 11.

sources.author: Jay Anderson
sources.title: UFC Vegas 119: Bia Mesquita Overcomes Early Adversity, Subs Melissa Mullins
